title: Keep matching numbers
summary: MATLAB: Keep matching numbers. Use a limit of 9.
introduction: A logical test makes a true-or-false mask for selecting values.

blocks.text: Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
The mask is false for 4 and true for 8 and 9. Those true positions survive.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use parentheses for indexing, not square brackets.
